host.description: IP address the health manager listens on.

port.description: Port the health manager listens on.

name.description: Name of this health manager instance.

health_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks to amphorae.

timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for health check operations.

successful_connections_before_active.description: Number of successful checks required before marking amphora active.

failed_connections_before_inactive.description: Number of failed checks before marking amphora inactive.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn.

update_frequency.description: Maximum number of health updates to buffer before forcing a flush to the database.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed health update batches.

retry_interval.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a failed health update.

stats_driver.description: Driver to use for emitting health statistics.

healthcheck_ip.description: IP used for health check traffic (e.g., VRRP VIP).

healthcheck_port.description: Port used for health check traffic.

status.description: Current provisioning status of the amphora.

amphorae.description: List of amphorae managed by this health manager instance.

name.description: Name of the health manager driver.

drivers.description: List of health manager driver configurations.

on_failed.description: Shell command executed when an amphora's health status becomes unhealthy.

on_succeeded.description: Shell command executed when an amphora's health status becomes healthy.

health_hooks.description: External command hooks for health status transitions.
